claude.sample_unit: patients (more than 400 across five datasets, ~9800 h of PPG recording)

links.outcome: AF detection AUROC/AUPRC and FPR with versus without inference-time augmentation under noise and distribution shift
links.effect: Standard ITA improved AUROC up to 8.5% (GPT-PPG) and 0.7% (ResNet), and AUPRC up to 10.6% and 0.8%, across all model-dataset combinations; selective ITA cut FPR up to 4.4% (GPT-PPG) and 1.3% (ResNet).
links.quote: Standard ITA consistently improved the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC, up to 8.5% for GPT-PPG and 0.7% for ResNet) and the area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC, up to 10.6% for GPT-PPG and 0.8% for ResNet) across all model-dataset combinations.

Selective inference-time augmentation applied only to positive predictions to reduce false positives
